input.mandate: Meme coins on Solana only. Never more than 5% of my allocation in one coin and no single buy over $150. Skip anything with under $250k in its pool. At most 6 trades an hour. Never trade a coin within 30 minutes of selling a signal on it.

output.plainEnglish: Meme Hunter may trade only on Solana, with no single trade over $150, no more than $100 (5% of $2,000) in any one coin, and only in coins whose pool holds at least $250,000. They can make at most 6 trades an hour and must wait 30 minutes after selling a signal on a coin before trading it. Your mandate did not name any banned coins, so we read 'meme coins only' as blocking the main non-meme Solana tokens (USDC, USDT and wrapped SOL).
